# Pinned-fetches gate exceptions (utah#902). One substring per line; a line
# suppresses any finding whose printed text contains it. Keep each entry
# next to the reason it is safe.

# Digest follows the tag on the same line; the pull is digest-locked.
os-minimal:latest@sha256:

# Developer-only VNC viewer for `just try-installed`; never runs in CI or
# ends up in an image.
UTAH_TRY_NOVNC_IMAGE

# TACKLEBOX_FROM_SOURCE path refuses without TACKLEBOX_SHA and checks out
# exactly that commit right after the clone.
git clone --quiet https://github.com/tuna-os/tacklebox.git .

# The candidate image is the digest-pinned ref the caller passes in; the
# rule cannot see across lines.
iso/scripts/lifecycle-e2e.sh

# rev-parse HEAD is compared to the pinned OGC_COMMIT right after the clone.
--branch "$OGC_TAG" https://github.com/OpenGamingCollective/linux.git
